set.body: Deliver checked playback evidence with edition identity, exact native coordinates, disjoint intervals and explicit points; connect supplied observations to existing computational consumers without promoting annotation text to film fact. Preserve prior graph IDs and replay. Positive/refusal cases, installed API/CLI workflow, deterministic readback and independent review. Direct-media construction remains an explicit obligation if not completed in this bounded slice.
set.title: P2 playback evidence through construction and computational consumption
